name: pega-infinity-authoring
description: Author Pega Infinity rules, case types, and applications, guided by bundled setup and authoring skills

setup.notice: Requires Node.js 22.14+ and Java 17+ on the machine running Devin; on first start the launcher downloads the MCP runtime. The first Pega call opens a browser OAuth sign-in on localhost, which only works when the browser runs on the same machine as the server.
steps: Enter the Pega Infinity environment root URL as PEGA_BASE_URL, without /prweb or another path segment.
Set PEGA_INFINITY_VERSION to 24-2, 25-1, or 26-1 to match the target environment (defaults to 26-1).
Start a session and run the pega-setup skill to verify the connection.
